name: OSINT — Geospatial Change Detection
description: Source-linked, sensor-aware change detection across satellite, aerial, map, and ground evidence.

tasks.name: Define area and change question
tasks.objective: Define area of interest, time window, target change class, required spatial/temporal resolution, baseline state, and confounders such as seasonality, agriculture, tides, snow, shadows, smoke, flooding, or routine construction.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The change question is measurable at available imagery resolution.

tasks.name: Build imagery ledger
tasks.objective: Collect suitable satellite/aerial imagery across dates and sensors, recording acquisition time, sensor/platform, bands, resolution, cloud cover, viewing angle, processing level, and source/license. Prefer comparable pairs but retain extra dates to distinguish transient artifacts from persistent change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every image used in comparison has acquisition and sensor metadata.

tasks.name: Register and normalize imagery
tasks.objective: Align imagery spatially, choose comparable bands/composites, account for projection/resolution differences, normalize visualization carefully, mask clouds/shadows where appropriate, and preserve raw data alongside processed views.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Apparent change is not introduced by misregistration or display scaling.

tasks.name: Detect candidate changes
tasks.objective: Use visual comparison, spectral indices, object/feature extraction, time-series statistics, or model-assisted segmentation appropriate to the question. Record both positive changes and stable reference features.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Candidate changes are spatially explicit and linked to source dates.

tasks.name: Corroborate on the ground
tasks.objective: Correlate candidate changes with public photos/videos, maps, permits, news, weather/disaster records, fire/flood products, road/construction data, ship/air activity where relevant, and historical imagery. Do not infer cause solely from pixel change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Causal interpretations use evidence beyond the change image itself.

tasks.name: Audit false change
tasks.objective: Challenge changes for cloud/shadow, phenology, crop cycle, water level/tide, snow, sun angle, sensor/resolution differences, compression, orthorectification, viewing geometry, smoke/haze, or temporary objects.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Persistent change is distinguished from transient or sensor-induced difference.

tasks.name: Package change evidence
tasks.objective: Deliver annotated before/after/time-series views, AOI geometry, acquisition metadata, processing steps, measurements, corroborating records, plausible causes, unresolved alternatives, confidence, and reproducible source links.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Another analyst can reproduce the comparison from the recorded imagery and processing choices.
